title: Alcohol stocks jump as blue wave boosts industry prospects
description: As the midterm elections unfold, investors are directing their focus to the alcohol sector, anticipating positive impacts on companies such as Constellation Brands due to shifting immigration policies. Optimism surrounding decreasing trade tensions with Canada also seems to uplift brands like Brown-Forman. However, the looming tariffs have caused a sharp decline in US spirits exports, and overall alcohol consumption in the country is still at historical lows, despite minor upticks.

title: Musk stocks lose $120 billion as Democrats’ Texas win rattles investors
description: Tesla and SpaceX lost more than $120 billion in combined market value after Democrats scored major election victories in Texas and across the US. Investors are concerned that a Democrat-controlled Congress could increase scrutiny of Elon Musk’s businesses, complicate a potential Tesla-SpaceX merger and create fresh regulatory hurdles.

title: Bitcoin rebounds with stocks despite threat to crypto agenda
description: Bitcoin rebounds more than 4% to above $81,000, tracking a broader recovery in financial markets after the US midterm elections. However, Democratic control of Congress threatens to stall crypto-friendly legislation and increase regulatory scrutiny. Investors are also weighing the impact of political uncertainty, Treasury yields and institutional adoption.

title: AI data center stocks dip, renewables surge after Democrat sweep in US midterm elections

Investors assessed the possibility of tighter AI oversight and continued clean energy support. Defence contractors and prison operators fell amid concerns over changing government spending and immigration policies.

title: US Treasury shifts language, opening door to auction size changes
description: The US Treasury Department has updated its regulations regarding upcoming auction sizes for treasury securities. This revision hints at a potential increase in the issuance of short- and intermediate-term debt. They also flagged a likely decrease in demand for longer-term 20- and 30-year auctions. Future adjustments will rely on demand trends and financial requirements, with the Treasury planning to consult market participants for a thorough understanding of these changing factors.

title: Meta draws record orders for debut euro bond sale, Bloomberg News reports
description: Meta Platforms has successfully garnered an impressive €53 billion in investor interest for its inaugural euro bond issuance. With an ambition to raise €9 billion divided into six distinct parts, this move follows their recent $15 billion bond offering in the US market. Citigroup and Morgan Stanley are at the helm of this euro bond sale, with pricing anticipated shortly. As of September 30, Meta's total debt reached $83.67 billion.

title: Gold gains 3% as dollar slides after Democratic midterm gains
description: On Wednesday, gold prices surged by 3%, reaching impressive new levels following the midterm elections, during which Democrats secured control of both the Senate and House. This political transformation, combined with a weaker dollar, heightened gold and precious metals demand. Investors are keenly watching for the upcoming US non-farm payrolls report, as rising interest rates and ongoing fiscal risk concerns continue to influence market sentiment.

title: Prediction markets get Democratic win right, with a few surprises
description: Prediction markets provided insights during the US midterm elections, with $1.48 billion wagered on the outcomes. Democrats gained control of both the Senate and House of Representatives after delivering a rebuke to Donald Trump. Despite some accurate forecasts, notable surprises emerged, such as Annie Andrews' victory in South Carolina against expectations. Kalshi and Polymarket reflected varying probabilities, emphasizing the predictive capabilities of betting markets.

title: Indian bonds rally most since April as oil slides after US midterm verdict
description: Indian government bonds experienced a significant rally influenced by falling oil prices after the US midterm elections. The benchmark bond yield dropped notably, reflecting a three-day decline in yields. Brent crude oil prices decreased, easing inflation and fiscal pressures on India. The Reserve Bank of India anticipates inflation will peak this quarter, supporting future bond market performance.
